name: CodeCraftGPT
description: A web app with a suite of AI-driven tools for intelligent code refactoring, style checking, test case generation, and cross-language translation, built with Python, Streamlit, and OpenAI.

paragraphs: CodeCraft GPT is an innovative, all-in-one platform harnessing the power of advanced Language Models (OpenAI). It seamlessly integrates four key components to elevate the coding experience for developers.
